sections.text:
-Ability Power 160. Damages all enemies 3 times with magic water damage at success of 100 points.
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Increases stats of all allies by 50% for 60 seconds
-Reduces Ability cooldown times (except for certain Abilities) for all allies by 20% for 50 seconds.
-Increases the Unison gauge gains of all allies by 3 for 50 seconds.
-Increases the Unison gauge of all allies excluding yourself by 15.
-Casts awakening on your character.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 5000
[Additional Unison Effect] Recovers 10 Cost for all allies.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 5000
[Unison Effect Boost] Recovers 15 Cost for all allies.
